prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce FOUR equal SQUARE scene cells in an exact 2 columns x 2 rows sheet, no gutters, borders, captions or text. Recompose the final powered habitat state from the reference into a WATER EXTRACTION scene with FOUR perfectly registered construction states; keep the reference's recognizable cream fabric starter dome, teal doorway trim, side round window, small square patch, roof satellite dish, single deployed two-leaf solar-array assembly LEFT of the doorway and existing compact AIR SCRUBBER RIGHT of it. This is the same habitat and equipment. Show it about 15 metres away, modestly small at top centre (dome x .43-.68, y .17-.42 per square). The one solar array is at its left and the air scrubber is beside its right. Retain their established electrical connections in all four cells. Do not put a water machine beside the habitat door.
Foreground: on a dry dusty rusty-red bench over buried ice, a small surveyed capped bore/casing at x .25,y .64 and a distinct compact cream/teal WATER PROCESSOR at x .72,y .62. Water processor is a modest open-framed treatment assembly with two slim cartridge cylinders and real left inlet/right outlet. It stands near the well, both around 15 m in front of the hab. Keep their entire footprints inside the cell, with quiet dusty ground below y .82. No exposed blue glacier or pond at the well, no steam, no people.
Row-major states: 1 TOP LEFT: bare short capped casing/collar only, small dusty drill spoil; processor waiting, no exterior WATER hoses. 2 TOP RIGHT: compact sealed heated extraction head fitted vertically onto the same casing, short insulated neck, small metal control block, obvious side outlet; no exterior WATER hoses. 3 BOTTOM LEFT: preserve that head and processor exactly; add TWO physically distinct continuous black water hoses. Short hose runs from well-head outlet across foreground to processor LEFT INLET, visibly connected at both ends. Separate LONG hose runs from processor RIGHT OUTLET in a graceful unbroken curve away across the ground to a dedicated small water service port on the distant HAB body. It goes around the solar array and door, never connects to the air scrubber. Both hoses wholly traceable, no gaps, no forks. 4 BOTTOM RIGHT: same exact two complete routes and connections, now clad in thin pale reflective insulated sleeves with small retaining bands; no route moves and no equipment moves. Both hoses stay continuous at connectors.
Style: richly painted realistic retro Mars adventure illustration, restrained cream/teal equipment, dusty ochre iron rock, warm but natural low sunlight, exposed metal and slight wear, elevated three-quarter camera. No decorative labels. All four cells share EXACT camera, landscape, shadows, dome, dish, array, scrubber, processor and bore footprint. Only the specified installed parts change. This source sheet will be cropped and registered; unchanged equipment must not drift.
